title: Interactive Geographical Atlas of the Kvemo Kartli Region (ქვემო ქართლის რეგიონის ინტერაქტიული გეოგრაფიული ატლასი)
description:
An interactive thematic web atlas of the Kvemo Kartli region of Georgia — one of the first interactive regional geographical atlases in Georgia. 58 thematic maps in seven blocks (population, nature, history, economy, education and culture, tourism, health and social services), each with a legend, information cards and statistical charts.

Produced at the Vakhushti Bagrationi Institute of Geography, Ivane Javakhishvili Tbilisi State University, with the financial support of the Shota Rustaveli National Science Foundation of Georgia (SRNSFG), grant FR-22-4153.

Website: https://romakumla.github.io/kvemo-kartli-atlas/. Built with Leaflet and Chart.js as a static site.
